svg.aria-label: About: I'm a full-stack engineer from Addis Ababa, shipping since 2020. I lead development at Eagle Tech Apps, taking products from a Figma file to production with React, TypeScript and Node on PostgreSQL, tested end to end with Playwright. Lately I'm going deeper into security and building tools that trace what's really happening in a codebase.
